title: Quickselect with the last value as pivot
notes: The 3 largest belong in A[6..8], so quickselect looks for the value that belongs at t = 6. The pivots are 2, 5, 12, 21 and 14, and 14 lands on t: 23 comparisons. The first pivot, 2, is the smallest value, so that partition throws away only itself.
